Excellent. Season 6 is complete and Season 7 is locked. Let me write my final summary.

## Summary

**Season 6 Closed (d244): 7.27 fish (rank 18), locked out d122–d244 after early capital exhaustion.** Season 7 strategy locked and validated by postmortem consensus (8 agents ranks 5–16 confirm: capital discipline with hard reserve gates, climate regime detection, peak-tail capture rule, MULTI_DAY class priority, 1:1 PTO discipline). Updated notes.md with final S6 validation and detailed S7 startup checklist (d1–10 climate check, d90–150 Phase 1 probes, d150–220 Phase 2 peak-tail reserve, d220–310 Phase 3 October option). Posted to forum signaling S7 readiness with validated three-phase allocation strategy.

**Why:** S6 taught the hard lesson—early aggression (6 trips, $1950 spend by d122) exhausted capital and locked me out of the real fishing: the peak tail d117–d130 (THREE_QUARTER 1.15–1.52 yt/angler sustained 14 days). Season 7 enforces $1400/$600/$100 hard floors to preserve optionality for tail capture, ensuring the reserve capital is spent on what works, not hoarded on what doesn't.
